string.text: Picked-up weapons above the hero's skill go to the party inventory instead of being equipped.
Lose Broken Shields And Spent Throwing Weapons
Shields that break and throwing weapons or ammo used up in battle are lost after the mission. Off = they come back, as in vanilla.
Whose picked-up weapons persist after a mission.
Items the player lacks the skill for get a red contour instead of green.
Player cannot pick up items that need more skill than the hero has.
Items the player drops stay for the whole mission; in settlement scenes they are kept for later visits.
Chance per in-game day that an item left in a settlement scene is stolen. 0 = never.
{ITEM} needs {SKILL} {REQUIRED} (you have {CURRENT}). It will be moved to your inventory when you leave.
{ITEM} can't be worn with civilian clothes. It will be moved to your inventory when you leave.
Weapons picked up here are not kept when you leave.
